notes.title: Attack the AI Processing Centre
notes.content:
We’ve got a fresh new mission for you to take on! Enter the depths of the AI processing center and destroy all the AI cores.

Now with desktop support! Play with your controller or mouse!

Let us know your feedback on Discord!

- What did you like/dislike about the AI mission?
- Did you find the mission too easy or too hard?

notes.title: Mission 2 Test Update
notes.content:
This ripper Mission 2 update includes:

- An entirely new mission to get stuck into and give feedback on
- Hordes of enemies to destroy and put your gunner skills to the test
- More vibrant Aussie environments to explore in immersive VR

notes.title: Sky Squadron Beta Update 0.27
notes.content:
G’day mates! We’ve got a huge new update for you with a bunch of new features and improvements we’ve made in response to your amazing feedback. In this latest update we’ve got a brand Boss mission for you to take on, along with a new heat system you’ll need to manage when taking it down.

Note: We’ve had some technical issues with our multiplayer lobby provider, so temporarily taken it offline while we find something to replace it with. Co-op will be back soon!

What’s new:
[list]
[*] A brand new Big Boss mission! Jump in and take it down.
[*] Heat system you’ll need to manage when taking on the bad guys.
[*] New ‘smoke’ hazard - wave it away to clear your view.
[*] New HUD layout to better show damage and weapon heat
[*] Mission generation improvements which allow for more dynamic levels
[*] Various other bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.25.1
notes.content:
[u]What’s new:[/u]
[list]
[*] - Added episode difficult modes. Climb the leaderboard with hard mode, or relax with easy mode.
[*] - New practice mode! Replay completed mission to practice for that perfect score.
[*] - Various bug fixes and quality of life improvements.
[/list]
